script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - NIGHT

JIM, mid-30s, glasses, disheveled hair, sits at a cluttered desk. He stares at a blank computer screen, deadlines looming. His eyes land on a flyer for a local stand-up comedy competition.

JIM
(to himself)
This could be my chance.

INT. COMEDY CLUB - DAY

Jim attends an open mic night. He watches other comedians bomb and succeed. He feels a spark.

JIM
(to himself)
I can do this.

INT. JIM'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jim types furiously at his computer, writing material for his act.

INT. COMEDY CLUB - NIGHT

Jim performs for the first time. He stumbles, but the audience laughs. He gains confidence.

INT. COMEDY CLUB - NIGHT (2 WEEKS LATER)

Jim performs in the competition's semi-finals. He nails it, impressing the judges.

INT. COMEDY CLUB - NIGHT (1 MONTH LATER)

Jim competes in the finals. The room is packed. His act receives thunderous applause. The winner is announced.

MC
(holding the trophy)
The winner of this year's comedy competition is... Jim!

INT. JIM'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jim celebrates with a bottle of champagne. He looks at himself in the mirror.

JIM
(to himself)
I did it.

INT. COMEDY CLUB - DAY

Jim receives a call from a talent agent who saw his performance.

INT. AGENT'S OFFICE - DAY

Jim meets with the agent. He's offered a shot at opening for a well-known comedian on a national tour. Jim is elated.

INT. COMEDY CLUB - NIGHT (2 MONTHS LATER)

Jim opens for the famous comedian. He's nervous, but the audience roars with laughter. The headliner introduces Jim with pride.

HEADLINER
(to the audience)
Ladies and gentlemen, I present to you, the future of comedy... Jim!

INT. JIM'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jim sits at his desk, now filled with awards and accolades. He smiles, knowing that his hard work has paid off.

FADE OUT.
